auth._note: apply.mjs reads credentials from the environment only. Either SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID + SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET (Dev Dashboard app, client credentials grant, 24-hour token) or SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN. Optional SHOPIFY_SHOP must match store above. The run stops if any scope below is missing.

hard_rules._note: Enforced by apply.mjs. The script never changes a collection handle or a product title, and stops if a planned change would delete a pre-existing collection or touch anything listed under do_not_touch.

do_not_touch._note: Summer Collection stays exactly as it is (title, handle, unpublished, products incl. Olive Whisper). Its redirect is changed under redirects.ensure (revised list, item 5).

matching.rule: Config titles match Shopify product titles case-insensitively after trimming. A title that matches zero products, or more than one without a pin below, stops the run.

handle_pins._note: These titles exist twice in Shopify: one ACTIVE product plus an older DRAFT duplicate. Each pin selects the product that was ACTIVE on 2026-11-18.

hide_products._note: Status set to DRAFT only. Memberships are kept, except in collections whose product list is set exactly.

Set to false once the family confirms: free delivery in Pakistan over Rs 30,000; pret dispatch 7 to 10 working days; formals 15 to 20 working days; a WhatsApp stylist. copy_edits below are approved and are not held.

product_redirects._note: Redirects for the 22 hidden products, /products/<handle> -> the By Collection collection each one belongs to. Titles resolve through handle_pins and title_aliases. Every hidden product must appear exactly once. An existing redirect with a different target is skipped and reported, never changed.

copy_edits._note: Exact text replacements in existing collection copy. Link targets stay /collections/pret. A replacement whose text is no longer found, and whose new text is not there either, stops the run.

edits.from: luxury pret, block print and formals
edits.to: everyday wear, block print and formals

assertions._note: by_collection lists must cover the active products after hiding exactly once each. Season lists plus unassigned_season must do the same.

cleanup._note: Leftovers from the first attempt on 2026-11-18. A collection is deleted only if its id matches, it was created on or after hard_rules.collections_created_during_task_on_or_after, and it has no products.

redirects._note: Must exist after the run. Missing ones are created after the cleanup deletes. An existing redirect is repointed only if its current target equals replace_target; any other target stops the run. A path held by an unpublished collection is fine: it returns 404, so the redirect applies (checked 2026-11-18 on /collections/summer-collection).

menu_order._note: Authoritative order of each item's children: collection links by handle, headings by title. Must list every child exactly once.
